blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) official, lawyer Gerardo Del Rosario, said the Constitution prohibits the vice president from holding another office or job, engaging in another profession or participating in a business while in office to avoid conflicts of interest. Del Rosario made the statement when prosecution counsel Erwin Matib asked whether a vice president could hold other employment after assuming office./dp READ: SEC records: Sara Duterte stayed company director after becoming vp...
